# Precoat Metals


## North America's leading independent provider of coil coating services

For over six decades, AZZ Precoat Metals has been a leading provider of coil-coated metal solutions, offering cost-effective options with enhanced corrosion resistance, customization, improved weather resistance, and aesthetic appeal. As North America’s leading independent provider of coil coating, our expertise in coatings and metals has resulted in end-use appearance and performance attributes across thousands of products and applications.


## Coil coating solutions engineered for durability and manufacturing efficiency


Through advanced coil coating technologies, integrated processing capabilities, and strategically located facilities, AZZ Precoat Metals helps customers improve manufacturing efficiency, product durability, and supply chain responsiveness. Centralized coil coating operations support consistent quality, efficient material utilization, and long-term product performance across a wide range of precoat metal applications.


## A one-stop-shop partner for coordinated coating and processing services


By consolidating multiple services within one coordinated coil coating network, AZZ helps customers reduce handling and transportation, streamline production workflows, improve production efficiency, and simplify supply chain coordination while maintaining consistent product quality and greater flexibility.


AZZ’s operational scale includes 14 strategically located Precoat facilities, 17 coating lines, and 19[value-added processing lines](https://www.azz.com/coil-coating-capabilities/) across the United States, helping customers strengthen supply chain continuity while benefiting from scalable production capacity and logistical advantages.


## Highly efficient supply chain logistics and production flexibility


With advanced processing capabilities and flexible production support, AZZ Precoat Metals gives customers the freedom to source metal from virtually any supplier while relying on AZZ for coordinated coating and processing services. Sourcing flexibility, warehousing capabilities, and strategic proximity to metal sources, demand centers, and major transportation routes help customers reduce logistical costs and improve supply chain efficiency.


Our toll processing model provides additional sourcing flexibility and late-point SKU identification, helping customers better align inventory and production with real-time market demand. This approach improves inventory management, supports faster response to changing business conditions, and helps reduce supply chain risk.


AZZ also supports accelerated production schedules through responsive manufacturing support and paint blend cell capabilities designed for quick turns on special colors, custom coatings, and evolving production requirements. Combined with a broad portfolio of[coating](https://www.azz.com/coating-solutions/) ,[printing](https://www.azz.com/printing/) ,[embossing](https://www.azz.com/embossing/) , and[finishing technologies](https://www.azz.com/coil-coating-capabilities/) , AZZ Precoat Metals helps customers execute projects tailored to specific aesthetic and performance objectives.


## Innovative coating technologies and specialty finishes


Our commitment to innovation allows us to bring a unique and diverse range of coating, printing, and embossing applications to your products and projects, including stone, wood grain, lush grass, and weathered finishes. We work closely with our customers and suppliers to develop solutions that enhance appearance and performance.


AZZ Precoat Metals continues to invest in[advanced coating technologies](https://www.azz.com/coating-solutions/) , operational systems, and capabilities designed to help customers improve product performance and manufacturing efficiency. Through Coilzone®, customers gain near real-time access to inventory, production, and shipping information, improving visibility and coordination throughout the supply chain.


From decorative finishes and specialty coatings to advanced performance systems engineered for demanding environments, AZZ helps customers create products that stand out in both appearance and durability.


## Shaping a stronger, more sustainable future


At AZZ Precoat Metals, we take pride in our[coil coating process](https://www.azz.com/coil-coating-process/) , recognized for its efficient material usage and minimal waste generation, setting us apart from traditional post-painting methods. Because it operates as a closed loop system, 98% of VOCs are captured and converted to fuel, making it an environmentally friendly process.


Coil coating is widely recognized as one of the most efficient and environmentally responsible methods for finishing metal products, delivering significant cost, quality, and environmental advantages compared to post-paint processes. Centralized, highly controlled environments help reduce energy consumption, improve paint utilization, minimize waste, and support the use of recyclable steel and aluminum substrates.


Our coated metal products provide superior weather and corrosion resistance, ensuring the longevity and durability of finished goods while helping customers reduce maintenance, extend product lifecycles, and improve long-term value. AZZ remains committed to advancing sustainability throughout the coil coating industry while helping customers meet growing environmental expectations without sacrificing product performance, operational efficiency, or quality.
